messages:
Zara Blake: hi folks, quick first-week question: where do people keep a personal ramp journal vs the canonical onboarding pages? also who owns the 'Quick Start - SDK' template so I can ask for edit rights? cc @DocsRelay
Omar Singh: welcome Zara! Personal ramp journals -> My Pages (private). Canonical onboarding lives in Company Wiki > Docs Library > Teams > Developer Experience. The SDK template is under Company Wiki > Templates > SDK. Owner is shown in the page properties (Owner: team-docs@redwood).
Emilia Ford: small nuance: some teams use a Team Space 'New Hires' folder for public ramp notes so folks can follow along; others keep everything private until it's ready. If you expect others to contribute, move to Team > New Hires and set permissions accordingly.
Zara Blake: how do I request ownership transfer if the template owner is a service account or outdated person?
Kenji Sato: open the template, top-right -> Page properties -> Owner. If it's a service account or old email, comment on the page tagging @TeamDocs and say "please reassign owner to @Devex". For audit we prefer the formal request though. Example comment text: "@TeamDocs please reassign owner from docs-bot@redwood to @Devex (team) for ongoing maintenance."
Zara Blake: is there a lightweight Slack command instead of a full form?
DocsRelay Bot: Snippet you can paste in #devex to create a ticket:
```
@DocsRelay request-owner-transfer --page "https://notion.redwood.company/Company/Templates/SDK/Quick-Start-SDK" --new-owner "team-devex" --reason "maintain v2 SDK examples"
```
This creates ticket DOC-13021 and pings TeamDocs. ETA 1 business day.
Omar Singh: FYI if you duplicate the template for your own edits, please mark the top with a short banner: "Forked from Quick-Start-SDK v2 - do not edit source" and keep a link to the canonical page. That helps when we reconcile improvements back to the template.
Emilia Ford: also if you plan to propose changes to canonical, create a short changelist in your duplicate and attach it to the ticket. Owners prefer a diff-like list not a huge page.
Zara Blake: great, I ran the snippet and got DOC-13021. last small thing: can I request comment-only access so I don't accidentally change the source?
Kenji Sato: yes — when you submit the request pick "Can comment" in permission level. DocsRelay defaults to comment for external/temporary edits. Owners can escalate to edit once they review.
Zara Blake: thanks all! saved a bunch of time. I'll keep my journal private and fork the template for now. :wave:
